problemStatement.summary: Users are experiencing issues with delayed deliveries, inaccurate offers, and poor customer support.
painPoints: Delayed deliveries leading to cold food
Inaccurate and outdated offers in certain locations
Poor customer support and unresolved issues
Higher menu prices compared to restaurant prices
userQuotes: the delivery gets really delayed other than that everything is nice the good gets cold before they arrive
Need to update Zomato offers in Navi Mumbai restaurants and hotels all back dated and wrong information

Zomato taking its customer for granted. while placing the order they will show some time and once the order is placed then they come to know that there is high demand and they double the delivery time
I ordered food on Sunday my money has been debited but they cancelled my order
why cod option is not working

successMetrics: Improve customer support satisfaction score by 25%
Decrease the number of complaints related to pricing discrepancies by 15%

userStories.soThat: I can enjoy it while it's still hot
I can make informed decisions about where to dine
my issues can be resolved promptly

userStories.soThat: I can pay for my order upon delivery

functional: Implement a real-time delivery tracking system to reduce delays
Update the offers database regularly to ensure accuracy
Enhance the customer support system with faster response times
Fix the cash on delivery functionality
nonFunctional: Ensure the app remains responsive under high demand

issues.title: Delayed Deliveries Leading to Cold Food
issues.description: Deliveries are often delayed, resulting in cold food upon arrival.
userQuotes: the delivery gets really delayed other than that everything is nice the good gets cold before they arrive
issues.suggestedFix: Implement a real-time delivery tracking system to reduce delays.

issues.title: Inaccurate and Outdated Offers
issues.description: Offers in certain locations are inaccurate and outdated, leading to customer dissatisfaction.
userQuotes: Need to update Zomato offers in Navi Mumbai restaurants and hotels all back dated and wrong information
issues.suggestedFix: Update the offers database regularly to ensure accuracy.

issues.title: Poor Customer Support and Unresolved Issues
issues.description: Customer support is slow and issues remain unresolved, leading to frustration.
userQuotes: Zomato taking its customer for granted.
issues.suggestedFix: Enhance the customer support system with faster response times.

issues.title: Non-functional Cash on Delivery Option
issues.description: The cash on delivery option is not working, affecting payment flexibility.
userQuotes: why cod option is not working
issues.suggestedFix: Fix the cash on delivery functionality.

issues.title: Higher Menu Prices Compared to Restaurant Prices
issues.description: Menu prices on the app are higher than the actual restaurant prices, leading to customer dissatisfaction.
issues.suggestedFix: Review and adjust menu pricing to align with restaurant prices.
